findings.evidence: `Isometry.lean:7-13` lists the heavy imports; the predicate is declared at line 108, while `RepresentationTheory/InvariantForm.lean:10` imports the module solely for uses beginning at line 145.
findings.fix: Split the dependency-light predicate and elementary pointwise/Mathlib bridges into an earlier basic isometry module (reorganizing under `BilinearForm/Isometry/` if needed), keep determinant/base-change/group extensions downstream, and make `InvariantForm` import only the basic module.
findings.issue: `BilinForm.IsIsometry` and its elementary API are broadly useful foundations, but their current home imports orthogonality, tensor products, matrices, determinants, and automorphism-group transport; `InvariantForm.lean:10,145` must import this entire module merely to state invariance.

summary: The foundational isometry predicate is placed behind an unnecessarily heavy group/determinant/base-change module, forcing representation theory to depend on unrelated later material.
